summary: 会话栏模型名称缩小自适应与底栏防换行优化

checks.name: 底栏工具行声明单行禁止换行，杜绝右侧按钮掉入第二行
checks.evidence: [data-composer-card] > [class*="row"]:has(> [class*="trailing"]) 强制声明 flex-wrap:nowrap!important; 消除折行现象

checks.name: 模型选择按钮声明弹性收缩与最大宽度限制
checks.evidence: [data-composer-card] [class*="trailing"] button[aria-haspopup='menu'] 声明 min-width:28px!important; max-width:220px; flex-shrink:1!important;

checks.name: 模型名称标签自适应缩短与省略截断防护
checks.evidence: [class*="triggerLabel"] 默认设置 max-width:120px; text-overflow:ellipsis; 并在 @media (max-width: 768px) 缩窄至 88px

checks.name: 左侧工具栏弹性收拢与右侧常驻对齐
checks.evidence: [class*="tools"] 声明 min-width:0; flex:1 1 auto; 右侧 [class*="trailing"] 声明 flex-shrink:0; 保持单行两端齐平
